title: Robot: comparable actuators sharing one command (wheel, joint or rotor motor currents)
note: Domain meaning only. No thresholds, no robot, no case.

groups.title: actuator currents

events.name: drive fault (fault state reaches its highest value)

groups.response_note: an actuator's current follows the present command: with the command fixed it has no trend of its own
groups.member_limit_reason_note: the drive recorded that an axis reached its current limit: the group's own protection, not an outside request

common.label: System-wide load increase
common.statement: Every actuator's current rose beyond its earlier relation to the command (payload, terrain, a shared drivetrain or supply): the group moved together.

component.label: Single-actuator deterioration
component.statement: One actuator's current moved apart from the others under the same command and reached the limit first.

drift.label: Rising friction or wear in one actuator
drift.statement: One actuator needs ever more current at the same command (bearing, gearbox, brake drag): its current drifts away from the group.

load.label: Lost torque constant or winding fault
load.statement: One actuator needs more current per unit of command (demagnetisation, winding or driver fault): its excess follows the command.

sensing.label: Current-sensing fault on one actuator
sensing.statement: One actuator's current reading is a measurement error: it jumps in ways the command and the other actuators do not explain.

external.label: Stop initiated outside the actuators
external.statement: A supervisor, operator or another protection initiated the stop; the actuators did not depart from their earlier behaviour before it.

external_checks.record: The drive controller's fault log covering the stop: which axis, which protection, threshold and command source
Each actuator's current response to a known command step at standstill and at speed
An independent current measurement (clamp) on the deviating actuator
The payload and terrain record for the run (what the whole machine carried and drove over)
